title: 5G NR LDPC GPU kernel tuning to real-time decode rate
description:
## Goal

Tune the GPU LDPC BP kernel for the 5G NR base graphs and
per-`i_LS` shift tables until at least one (BG, lifting set,
rate) configuration achieves real-time decode rate on gfx1030
(matches the 3GPP TS 38.214 PRB throughput at the configured
target BLER).

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR LDPC real-time and research
enablers) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). This is the
headline benchmark for the epic. Placeholder body — project-lead
expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] At least one (BG, lifting set, rate) configuration
  achieves real-time decode rate on gfx1030 with documented
  measurement vs spec PRB throughput.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: receipt under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/5g-nr-realtime.md` records the
  configuration, throughput target, observed throughput, and
  margin.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
